text:
maria: Need to spin up a new GPU pool in europe-north1 for a mixed workload (low-latency chat + nightly batch finetune). Quota in that region is low for GPUs. Thinking: small T4 pool for realtime, separate A100/large nodes for batch. Anyone see problems with that split?
chen: sounds fine. two pools makes sense. keep realtime pool small and autoscaled aggressively. batch on reserved or dedicated to avoid preemption.
maria: thinking node counts: realtime min=0 max=6, batch min=1 max=4. autoscaler behavior: prefer scale-up latency <30s for realtime.
harry: cluster-autoscaler scaling latency depends on instance startup and GPU drivers. if you want <30s, need warm pool (one idle node) or overprovisioner. autoscaler + node-provisioner alone won't hit 30s.
samir: +1 to warm instance. use a cheap baseline node (t4) pinned with kube-system daemonset so it's quick. also consider using spot for batch A100 to save cost but reserve 1-on-demand A100 for urgent jobs.
ellie: driver question: are we on GPU-operator? need to ensure node image has NVIDIA drivers and containerd GPU support. if we use preemptible/spot, driver install on boot can add 60-90s. recommend baked image with drivers.
chen: agree. we should bake a GPU image via Packer/Golden AMI with GPU operator runlevel enabled. then node pool create is fast. example GKE create:```gcloud container node-pools create gpupool-t4-realtime \
  --cluster=prod-inference \
  --region=europe-north1 \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-8 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=0 --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=6 \
  --node-taints=inference=realtime:NoSchedule \
  --enable-autoscaling````
maria: that looks good. for batch A100 pool:```gcloud container node-pools create gpupool-a100-batch \
  --cluster=prod-inference \
  --region=europe-north1 \
  --machine-type=n1-highmem-32 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=1 --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=4 \
  --preemptible``` but we should keep 1 non-preemptible if SLA required.
chen: important: region quota for A100 might be 0 by default. please open quota increase with cloud console. I can paste a template for quota request.
ops-bot: Quota request created (ticket #Q-11283) for project:redwood-prod region:europe-north1 resource:accelerator (A100). Support contact: cloud-support@example.com
harry: autoscaler config notes: set expander=prioritized, use node-group priorities so realtime scales first from T4 pool and batch scales to A100 only when queue depth high. also set scale-down-delay=10m to avoid churn.
samir: cost note: T4 ~ low per-hour; A100 expensive—suggest rate-limiting batch job concurrency + queueing + per-job resource hints to avoid over-requesting GPUs. we should enable VerticalPodAutoscaler? maybe not needed.
ellie: for scheduling, use nodeSelector + tolerations + priorityClass for realtime. example pod spec snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: realtime-worker
spec:
  priorityClassName: high-realtime
  tolerations:
  - key: "inference"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "realtime"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  nodeSelector:
    cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-tesla-t4
  containers:
  - name: worker
    image: gcr.io/redwood/realtime:prod
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
maria: good. who can request quota increases for A100 and T4? I don't have the perms.
chen: I will file the official quota increase for A100, T4 and CPUs in that region. ping me if you want the cloud ticket id.
harry: ops follow-ups: - add baked GPU image to image catalog - add warm node pool with min=1 for realtime - update autoscaler priorities - document runbook for driver-related boot failures
samir: also check nodePool max surge limits in cluster upgrade docs. upgrading during heavy batch windows could reduce capacity. schedule maintenance window.
ellie: one last thing: CI still uses older CUDA, test GPU-operator + runtime image in staging before we create the pools.
maria: thanks team. action items: @chen file quotas + paste ticket here, @chen bake image or assign to eng-infra, @harry prepare autoscaler config PR, @samir estimate monthly cost delta for keeping a warm t4 node vs cold start. I'll wait for ticket and then we'll approve. :thumbsup:
